topic: A01 Adoption Is Not Impact: How to Prove a GenAI Rollout Actually Worked
data: Synthetic. 60 customer-support teams (6 regions x 10), observed weekly for 24 weeks; AI assistant rolled out in 3 waves of 20 teams (weeks 7, 13, 19). Common trend +0.05/week. True effect ramps to an established ~0.38 tickets per agent-hour over 3 weeks (about 0.29 averaged over the first 6 weeks). True effect on reopen rate = 0. Seed 20261105.
how_to_reproduce: python3 data/generate_data.py; Rscript r/analysis.R; python3 python/analysis.py
ci_method: 95% CIs use the normal approximation (1.96) with team-clustered SEs. CR1 for regressions; influence-function SEs for group-time ATTs (group sizes treated as fixed).

results.meaning: Clean team-weeks analysed (60 teams x 24 weeks minus gaps).

results.name: n_missing_teamweeks

results.name: wave1_pre_mean
results.meaning: Wave-1 mean, weeks 1-6 (before launch).

results.name: wave1_post_mean
results.meaning: Wave-1 mean, weeks 7-12 (after launch).

results.name: comparison_pre_mean
results.meaning: Comparison (waves 2-3) mean, weeks 1-6.

results.name: comparison_post_mean
results.meaning: Comparison (waves 2-3) mean, weeks 7-12 (still without the assistant).

results.name: naive_before_after_wave1
results.meaning: NAIVE: wave-1 mean after minus before (weeks 7-12 vs 1-6). Overstates the effect about 2x.

results.name: naive_before_after_se
results.meaning: Team-clustered SE of the naive gain (precise, but precisely wrong).

results.name: comparison_change
results.meaning: Change in comparison teams over the same weeks: what would have happened anyway.

results.name: did_2x2
results.meaning: Classic 2x2 DiD: wave 1 vs not-yet-treated teams, weeks 1-12. The article's AI effect.

results.name: did_2x2_se
results.meaning: Team-clustered (CR1) standard error of the 2x2 DiD.

results.name: did_2x2_ci_low
results.meaning: 95% CI lower bound of the 2x2 DiD (normal approximation).

results.name: did_2x2_ci_high
results.meaning: 95% CI upper bound of the 2x2 DiD; excludes the naive +0.60.

results.name: naive_to_did_ratio
results.meaning: Naive gain divided by the DiD effect (about 2: half the gain was not the AI).

results.name: did_share_of_naive
results.meaning: Share of the naive gain that the assistant caused.

results.name: did_pct_of_baseline
results.meaning: DiD effect relative to wave-1 pre-launch level.

results.name: pretrend_slope_diff
results.meaning: Parallel-trends check: wave-1 minus comparison weekly slope, weeks 1-6 (should be ~0).

results.name: pretrend_slope_diff_se
results.meaning: Team-clustered SE of the pre-trend slope difference.

results.name: twfe_att
results.meaning: NAIVE staggered: two-way fixed effects coefficient on 'has assistant', all 24 weeks. Biased low.

results.name: twfe_se
results.meaning: Team-clustered SE of the TWFE coefficient (precise but biased).

results.name: twfe_ci_low
results.meaning: 95% CI lower bound, TWFE.

results.name: twfe_ci_high
results.meaning: 95% CI upper bound, TWFE; excludes the true effect over the group-time cells (0.318) and over all treated team-weeks (0.335).

results.name: cs_att_overall
results.meaning: Group-time (Callaway & Sant'Anna style) overall ATT, waves 1-2, weeks up to 18.

results.name: cs_att_overall_se
results.meaning: Team-clustered SE (influence function) of the overall group-time ATT.

results.name: cs_att_overall_ci_low
results.meaning: 95% CI lower bound, overall group-time ATT.

results.name: cs_att_overall_ci_high
results.meaning: 95% CI upper bound, overall group-time ATT.

results.name: cs_att_established
results.meaning: Group-time ATT 3+ weeks after launch: the established effect.

results.name: cs_att_established_se
results.meaning: SE of the established effect.

results.name: cs_att_wave1_weeks7to12
results.meaning: Group-time ATT for wave 1, weeks 7-12 (same target as the 2x2 DiD).

results.name: cs_leads_chi2
results.meaning: Joint chi-square of placebo leads, event times -6 to -2 (5 df).

results.name: cs_leads_p
results.meaning: p-value of the placebo-lead test (large = no sign of diverging pre-trends).

results.name: true_att_wave1_weeks7to12
results.meaning: TRUTH: average true effect, wave 1, weeks 7-12 (target of naive and 2x2 DiD).

results.name: true_att_cs_cells
results.meaning: TRUTH: average true effect over the cells the group-time ATT covers (target of TWFE and group-time ATT).

results.name: true_att_established
results.meaning: TRUTH: average true effect 3+ weeks after launch (same cells as cs_att_established).

results.name: true_att_all_treated
results.meaning: TRUTH: average true effect over every treated team-week incl. weeks 19-24.

results.name: bias_naive
results.meaning: Naive before-after minus truth.

results.name: bias_did_2x2
results.meaning: 2x2 DiD minus truth.

results.name: bias_twfe_vs_cs_cells

results.name: bias_twfe_vs_all_treated

results.name: bias_cs
results.meaning: Group-time ATT minus truth.
